name: developer-product-configuration
description: Verify four configured Robux Developer Products plus four configured Honor products, live metadata, regional prices, bounded world offers, authoritative grants, and clean runtime without opening a purchase prompt.

steps.label: wait for product catalog and regional prices

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local M=game:GetService('MarketplaceService') local cfg=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local expected={CoinPack={'Hero Coin Pack',3708736246,29},SpinPack={'3 Hero Spins',3708736283,49},CoinBoost={'2X Coins 15 Minutes',3708736312,49},TrainingBoost={'2X Training 15 Minutes',3708736344,59}} local honorExpected={HonorPouch25={'Honor Pouch',25,3708804891,29},HonorCache90={'Honor Cache',90,3708804911,79},HonorVault300={'Honor Vault',300,3708804933,199},HonorTreasury850={'Honor Treasury',850,3708804944,499}} local rows,honorRows,ids,ok={},{},{},true for _,product in ipairs(cfg.PremiumProducts) do if (product.shopPage or 'Robux')=='Robux' then local e=expected[product.id] local success,info=pcall(function() return M:GetProductInfoAsync(product.productId,Enum.InfoType.Product) end) local row={key=product.id,name=product.displayName,id=product.productId,configuredPrice=product.robux,lookup=success} if success then row.liveName=info.Name row.livePrice=info.PriceInRobux row.userBasePrice=info.UserBasePriceInRobux row.forSale=info.IsForSale row.match=info.Name==product.displayName and (tonumber(info.PriceInRobux) or 0)>0 and info.IsForSale==true else row.error=tostring(info) row.match=false end row.config=e and product.displayName==e[1] and product.productId==e[2] and product.robux==e[3] and product.worldOffer==true or false ok=ok and row.config and row.match and not ids[product.productId] ids[product.productId]=true table.insert(rows,row) elseif product.shopPage=='Honor' then local e=honorExpected[product.id] local success,info=pcall(function() return M:GetProductInfoAsync(product.productId,Enum.InfoType.Product) end) local livePrice=success and tonumber(info.PriceInRobux) or 0 local exact=e and product.displayName==e[1] and product.honor==e[2] and product.productId==e[3] and product.robux==e[4] and product.worldOffer==false and success and info.Name==e[1] and livePrice>0 and info.IsForSale==true and not ids[product.productId] ids[product.productId]=true honorRows[#honorRows+1]={key=product.id,honor=product.honor,id=product.productId,configuredBasePrice=product.robux,liveName=success and info.Name,livePrice=livePrice,forSale=success and info.IsForSale,exact=exact==true} ok=ok and exact end end local result={ok=ok and #rows==4 and #honorRows==4,count=#rows,honorCount=#honorRows,rows=rows,honorRows=honorRows} assert(result.ok,'Developer Product metadata mismatch '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: live Roblox Developer Product identities and regional prices are available

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local cfg=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local root=workspace:WaitForChild('PunchWallRPG') local rows,honorWorld,ok={},0,true for _,product in ipairs(cfg.PremiumProducts) do local board=root:FindFirstChild(product.displayName..' Premium Offer',true) if product.worldOffer==false then if board then honorWorld+=1 end ok=ok and board==nil else local detector=board and board:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('ClickDetector',true) local row={key=product.id,id=product.productId,board=board~=nil,detector=detector~=nil,configured=board and board:GetAttribute('PurchaseConfigured')==true and board:GetAttribute('PurchaseUnavailable')==false and board:GetAttribute('OfferKind')=='DeveloperProduct'} ok=ok and row.board and row.detector and row.configured table.insert(rows,row) end end local result={ok=ok and #rows==4 and honorWorld==0,count=#rows,honorWorld=honorWorld,rows=rows} assert(result.ok,'Developer Product world mapping mismatch '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: all four world offers expose configured authoritative purchase paths

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local M=game:GetService('MarketplaceService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD') local a=g:WaitForChild('PunchWallClientAutomation') local cfg=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) assert(a:Invoke('OpenShopPage','Robux')==true,'Robux shop did not open') local function cardFor(product) local shop=g.GameMenu:FindFirstChild('FunctionalHeroShop') return shop and shop:FindFirstChild(product.id..'ShopCard',true) end local robuxProducts={} for _,product in ipairs(cfg.PremiumProducts) do if (product.shopPage or 'Robux')=='Robux' then robuxProducts[#robuxProducts+1]=product end end local deadline=os.clock()+8 local allResolved=false repeat task.wait(.1) allResolved=true for _,product in ipairs(robuxProducts) do local card=cardFor(product) allResolved=allResolved and card~=nil and card:GetAttribute('RegionalPriceResolved')==true end until allResolved or os.clock()>=deadline local root=workspace:WaitForChild('PunchWallRPG') local rows,ok={},allResolved for _,product in ipairs(robuxProducts) do local card=cardFor(product) local action=card and card:FindFirstChild(product.id..'Action',true) local priceLabel=card and card:FindFirstChild('Price',true) local lookup,info=pcall(function() return M:GetProductInfoAsync(product.productId,Enum.InfoType.Product) end) local livePrice=lookup and tonumber(info.PriceInRobux) or 0 local displayed=card and tonumber(card:GetAttribute('DisplayedRobuxPrice')) or 0 local board=root:FindFirstChild(product.displayName..' Premium Offer',true) local worldText='' if board then for _,d in ipairs(board:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('TextLabel') and d.Name=='Subtitle' then worldText..=' '..string.upper(d.Text or '') end end end local row={key=product.id,id=product.productId,livePrice=livePrice,displayed=displayed,card=card~=nil,action=action~=nil,configured=card and card:GetAttribute('PurchaseConfigured')==true and action and action:GetAttribute('PurchaseConfigured')==true,resolved=card and card:GetAttribute('RegionalPriceResolved')==true and action and action:GetAttribute('RegionalPriceResolved')==true,price=displayed==livePrice and priceLabel and tonumber(priceLabel.Text)==livePrice and action.Text=='BUY',world=board and board:GetAttribute('RegionalPriceResolved')==true and tonumber(board:GetAttribute('DisplayedRobuxPrice'))==livePrice and worldText:find('R$ '..livePrice,1,true)~=nil} ok=ok and lookup and row.card and row.action and row.configured and row.resolved and row.price and row.world table.insert(rows,row) end assert(a:Invoke('OpenShopPage','Honor')==true,'Honor shop did not open') local honorProducts={} for _,product in ipairs(cfg.PremiumProducts) do if product.shopPage=='Honor' then honorProducts[#honorProducts+1]=product end end deadline=os.clock()+8 local honorResolved=false repeat task.wait(.1) honorResolved=true for _,product in ipairs(honorProducts) do local card=cardFor(product) honorResolved=honorResolved and card and card:GetAttribute('RegionalPriceResolved')==true end until honorResolved or os.clock()>=deadline local honorRows,honorOk={},honorResolved for _,product in ipairs(honorProducts) do local card=cardFor(product) local action=card and card:FindFirstChild(product.id..'Action',true) local lookup,info=pcall(function() return M:GetProductInfoAsync(product.productId,Enum.InfoType.Product) end) local livePrice=lookup and tonumber(info.PriceInRobux) or 0 local exact=card and action and lookup and info.Name==product.displayName and info.IsForSale==true and product.productId>0 and card:GetAttribute('ProductId')==product.productId and card:GetAttribute('PurchaseConfigured')==true and card:GetAttribute('PurchaseUnavailable')==false and card:GetAttribute('RegionalPriceResolved')==true and card:GetAttribute('DisplayedRobuxPrice')==livePrice and action:GetAttribute('DisplayedRobuxPrice')==livePrice and action.Active==true and action.Selectable==true and action:GetAttribute('ShopActionBound')==true and action.Text=='BUY' honorRows[#honorRows+1]={key=product.id,id=product.productId,price=card and card:GetAttribute('DisplayedRobuxPrice'),livePrice=livePrice,exact=exact==true} honorOk=honorOk and exact end local spinPack for _,product in ipairs(cfg.PremiumProducts) do if product.id=='SpinPack' then spinPack=product break end end local spin=g.HeroSpinModal.SpinPanel:FindFirstChild('BuyBonusSpins') local spinOk=spin and spin:GetAttribute('ProductId')==spinPack.productId and spin:GetAttribute('RegionalPriceResolved')==true and tonumber(spin:GetAttribute('DisplayedRobuxPrice'))>0 local result={ok=ok and #rows==4 and honorOk and #honorRows==4 and spinOk,count=#rows,honorCount=#honorRows,honorOk=honorOk,spinOk=spinOk,spinPrice=spin and spin:GetAttribute('DisplayedRobuxPrice') or 0,rows=rows,honorRows=honorRows} assert(result.ok,'Developer Product regional UI mismatch '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: Shop, Spin modal, and world boards display each player's live regional price

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local c=game.ServerStorage:WaitForChild('PunchWallAutomation') c:Invoke('Reset') local before=workspace:GetServerTimeNow() local coin=c:Invoke('GrantPremiumProduct','CoinPack') local spin=c:Invoke('GrantPremiumProduct','SpinPack') local coinBoost=c:Invoke('GrantPremiumProduct','CoinBoost') local trainingBoost=c:Invoke('GrantPremiumProduct','TrainingBoost') local snapshot=c:Invoke('Snapshot') local result={ok=coin.ok==true and spin.ok==true and coinBoost.ok==true and trainingBoost.ok==true and snapshot.Coins==7500 and snapshot.SpinCredits==3 and (snapshot.CoinBoostExpiresAt or 0)>=before+899 and (snapshot.TrainingBoostExpiresAt or 0)>=before+899,coins=snapshot.Coins,spins=snapshot.SpinCredits,coinBoostSeconds=(snapshot.CoinBoostExpiresAt or 0)-before,trainingBoostSeconds=(snapshot.TrainingBoostExpiresAt or 0)-before} c:Invoke('Reset') assert(result.ok,'Developer Product grant mapping mismatch '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)
